fullPassage: Dear Ms. Lopez, We want to express our gratitude for your dedication as a Spanish instructor. With exceptional teaching skills, you have significantly improved our students' progress and confidence in Spanish. As the year is about to end, it is time for us to reflect on your contributions and consider the renewal of your contract. Given your positive impact, we would like to offer an extension of your contract for the next academic year. We believe your continued involvement will further enhance our students' learning experience and academic achievement. We look forward to your response. Sincerely, James Martin, Principal

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Dear Ms. Lopez, We want to express our gratitude for your dedication as a Spanish instructor. With exceptional teaching skills, you have significantly improved our students' progress and confidence in Spanish.

(A) Given your positive impact, we would like to offer an extension of your contract for the next academic year. We believe your continued involvement will further enhance our students' learning experience and academic achievement.

(B) As the year is about to end, it is time for us to reflect on your contributions and consider the renewal of your contract.

(C) We look forward to your response. Sincerely, James Martin, Principal

det.korean: 감사+성과 → (B) 학년말 돌아보고 갱신 고려 → (A) 연장 제안 → (C) 답변 기대
det.analysis:
① (B) — (A) — (C): 고려 → 제안 → 마무리 ←정답
② (A) — (B) — (C): 제안이 '고려' 앞에 옴 부자연
③ (C) — (A) — (B): 마무리가 먼저 올 수 없음
④ (B) — (C) — (A): 마무리 뒤에 제안 부자연

det.korean: ② — '계약 갱신을 고려한다' 다음에 '계약 연장을 제안한다'는 구체적 내용이 자연스럽게 이어지고, 그 뒤에 '지속적 참여'가 이어짐
det.analysis:
❌ ①: 아직 '고려' 언급 전
✅ ②: 갱신 고려 직후 연장 제안 ←정답
❌ ③: 이미 지속적 참여 언급 후
❌ ④: 마무리 뒤
det.tip: consider renewal → offer extension → continued involvement
